\begin{document}
For real $a$ and $c$, take fermionic Matsubara frequencies.  In this
nonequilibrium calculation $n_F$ denotes an arbitrary occupation function,
not the thermal Fermi distribution.  The claimed fermionic Matsubara sum is
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{\beta}\sum_n \frac{1}{(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-a)(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-c)}
= \frac{n_F(a)-n_F(c)}{a-c} .
\label{eq:redefined-fermi-symbol}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
